what: Chapter title card over the dark veil covering the screen. The title letters reshuffle into runes and symbols (ᚠᚢᚦ…✦◈⟁) every two frames, then from 220ms to 1.5s they lock in one by one from the front and glow. At the same time the title, spread at .33em letter-spacing and 10px blur, gathers in over 1.6s with power3.out. The heading rises from 12px below over .9s after .4s. The subtitle settles in from 8px above over .9s (power2.out) after 1.6s, and the progress bar fills over 3s with power1.inOut. At 3s, after a .25s pause, the text lines leave with 14px blur and a 10px upward drift (.55s, .05 stagger, power2.in), and the veil lifts over .9s with power2.inOut

options.hold: How long the veil holds (ms), default 3000 — shorten it for screens that change often, like apps
options.lock · from: When all letters are submerged · when the first letter is submerged (ms), default 1500 · 220
options.spread: Initial letter spacing (em), default .33 (901px and up) · 0 when narrow
options.gate: If wait, holds on even after hold has passed until fx:open is received (until the artwork·scene is ready)
options.max: Max wait for the gate (ms), default 12000
options.chars: Set of characters to shuffle, default 24 runes + ✦◈⟁☉△▲
options.[data-fx-part=caption] · [data-fx-part=s: Top heading (”— Part I —”) · subtitle below
options.fx:done: Event that bubbles up from the element once the curtain has fully lifted
